name: fable-engine
description: A tiny, framework-free TypeScript engine for interactive narratives, with a Canvas 2D player and self-contained HTML export.
author: Randerson Oliveira Melville Rebouças
contributors: Marcelo Magalhães Foohs (pedagogical design — Active Remediation Cycle)
